title: Manager at an Electronics Contract Manufacturer Expects AI-Driven PCB Demand to Stay Strong but Sees Reliability and Margin Risks
expert: Manager, PCB production/SQE at a Hon Hai-subsidiary server contract manufacturer
verdict: The expert's own AI-server PCB demand rose at least 80% y/y in Q3 2026 [[12 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-261986&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse10722&hl=fse10722,fse11014&page=2), but he sees laminate price increases as limited and margins compressed by Shenghong's state-backed share push [[15 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-261986&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse37881&hl=fse37881&page=2).

Like-for-like pricing: 🔴 price increases limited and EMC-vs-peer price gaps not very significant, vs the 5–20% M7+ hike round on the 3Q26 call (SB #66487): conflicting. → Tenet 1 (pricing power) ↓ [[15 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-261986&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse37881&hl=fse37881&page=2) [[28 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-261986&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse40286&hl=fse40286,fse40636,fse40769,fse41642&page=2)

🟡 AI multilayer PCB inventory ≤3 weeks, supply and demand "balanced", vs EMC PM's "particularly large" M8 gap (SB #64966): conflicting. [[5 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-261986&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse23695&hl=fse23695,fse23775,fse23905&page=2)
GM trajectory: 🔴 margins compressed by Shenghong competition, vs 3Q26 GM +3.8ppt q/q (SB #62346): conflicting (expert has no view of EMC financials). [[15 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-261986&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse37881&hl=fse37881&page=2)
Shengyi / TUC high-end progress: 🔴 Shenghong holds the highest global share with state support (hearsay), consistent with UBS's Shengyi VR200 share on par with Elite (SB #61039). → Tenet 3 (dominant share) ↓ [[10 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-261986&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse37633&hl=fse37633,fse37802,fse37881&page=2)

🟢 smaller Chinese laminate suppliers have limited high-end traction without IPC/AEC certification; first read. → Tenet 3 (dominant share) ↑ [[11 • Expert Call] ](https://research.alpha-sense.com?docid=EC-1000000-261986&scope=ANYWHERE&stmt=fse54601&hl=fse54601,fse55186,fse55276&page=2)

changes: Pricing: expert sees price increases as limited vs the second 5–20% M7+ hike round on the 3Q26 call (SB #66487) and GS's M8 ~+10% (SB #62349): conflicting.
Supply: AI PCB inventory ≤3 weeks and "balanced" vs EMC PM's "particularly large" 2026 M8 gap (SB #64966) and Citi's unchanged 2027 undersupply (SB #62442): conflicting.
Margins: "compressed" vs 3Q26 GM +3.8ppt q/q and OPM 30.7% (SB #62346): conflicting.
Competition: Shenghong highest global share vs UBS's Shengyi VR200 share on par with Elite (SB #61039) and mgmt seeing 2nd/3rd-source qualification (SB #66541): consistent, competition rising.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (supply-constrained pricing power): ↓ — expert sees limited price increases and ≤3 weeks of AI PCB inventory, against mgmt's 5–20% hike round.
Tenet 2 (grade ladder): ↑ — boards moving from 24 to as many as 40 layers; 18+ layer material demand ~+80% (estimate).
Tenet 3 (AI content and dominant share): ↓ — Shenghong cited as highest-share, margin-compressing rival; partly offset by certification barriers for smaller Chinese suppliers.
